title: Grayton Beach "Magnolia Dream" 205 Magnolia Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Private heated pool **Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $40 per day**- 2 nearby beach accesses only minutes away- Short bike ride to AJs, Red Bar, Chiringo, and more - New 2018 construction- Large screened-in porch- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Bocce ball court- Parking for 3 vehicles- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Welcome to Magnolia Dream, a newly constructed, luxurious home located in the heart of Grayton Beach! With beautiful finishes and decor, a dreamy outdoor oasis, and 5 bedrooms, this professionally designed home is completely swoon-worthy. It's centrally located on a quiet street just a few blocks from a public beach access and Grayton's restaurants like the famous Red Bar, Chiringo, and AJ's! The outdoor living areas are exquisite, and the private pool and bocce ball court provide great entertainment for all ages when not enjoying the beach. There is also a covered grilling area and patio that is the perfect spot to hang out and relax by the pool. Upon entering the home, guests will fall in love with the coastal charm in the open concept living area. Sophisticated decor aligns with the white shiplap walls, stainless steel appliances, and open cabinetry in the kitchen. Ten guests can sit comfortably at the dining table, with additional seating for 4 at the breakfast bar. A screened-in porch with outdoor dining is directly off the kitchen, making al fresco meals a breeze! There is also a powder room down the hall to add extra convenience. The spacious primary suite, located down the hall, features a cozy king bed, access to the patio, and double-vanity bathroom attached. The second floor also has a nearly identical primary suite with its own balcony access and private bathroom. There are 2 bunk rooms on this floor, both with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, each with their own bathroom. The second and third floors both have additional sitting areas to spread out and overlook the balconies. The third floor features a guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and a common bathroom. The top-level balcony has stunning, unobstructed vistas of the sparkling emerald green waters that will take your breath away at sunset. This home is ideal for multi-generational families - the primary suite is on the main floor. The home is located on Grayton's quiet side - accessible to all of the amenities you love in Grayton. The home has access to a large public beach within a couple minutes' walk with the access point through the dunes off Pine St. Enjoy using the 5 adult bikes for cruising to the beach or to breakfast at Crackings down the street. Don't miss your chance to stay at "Magnolia Dream!"SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Bunk Bedroom: Two Built-in Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Bunk Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*During June and July, the home is only available to rent from Saturday to Saturday.
